description: A React component test file that tests the App component, including mocking fetch calls to external weather APIs and verifying UI rendering and user interactions.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a global fetch mock before each test to simulate API responses for weather data.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets all jest mocks after each test.

methods.name: test('renders header brand and search UI')
methods.description: Verifies that the App component renders the header, branding, and search UI elements.
